assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I25.10 is assigned for atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The diagnosis code I34.0 is assigned for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The CPT code for the mobile cardiac telemetry procedure is 93229
The symptoms of dizziness and giddiness are documented
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The member retains the right to appeal this determination
